title: 15 Taps Become One Scrub in the Dose Calculator | vitalii.no
description:
Bumping a carb value from 40 grams to 55 meant tapping a tiny plus button fifteen separate times, on a phone screen already crowded with the rest of the dose card. Swipe a food row by accident and it was simply gone — the only way back was re-adding it and recalculating the whole day's log by hand.

A new motion module adds press-and-hold-to-repeat and a horizontal scrub gesture directly on every value — carbs, blood sugar, ketones, given dose — plus a bottom-sheet product picker and a swipe-to-delete with an Undo snackbar that reverses the same delete call already used by the journal. The underlying insulin math was never touched; every value still flows through the same input event it always did.

Changing a carb value by 15 grams now takes one scrub instead of fifteen taps, and an accidental swipe-delete is recoverable for 5 seconds instead of a manual re-entry of the whole row.
